name: foreman
description: An omp extension (slash commands, skills, and agents; commands are invoked as /foreman:<name> once installed as a plugin) that packages a GitHub-issue-tracker-driven dev workflow (ideas -> epics/tasks -> worktrees -> stacked PRs -> operator merge) for any project. The plugin/package is named 'foreman' for a short command prefix; it's distributed from the 'omp-foreman' repo to avoid colliding with the unrelated 'foreman' process manager on npm/rubygems as a published package name.
